title: 第20章 学院的规矩
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
血怒的目光扫过那几个还在坚持的身影，眼中闪过一丝满意。

    “感觉到了吗？”

    他的声音依旧平静，仿佛那股恐怖的威压与他无关，

    “这就是力量。二级巫师的力量。我只是一个眼神，都没有释放巫术，你们，就只有几个人站得住。而我，在学院里并不是那么强。”

    威压骤然消失。

    那些瘫坐在地的新生大口喘着气，有人甚至忍不住哭了出来。

    刚才那一瞬间，他们真切地感受到了死亡的气息。

    那种毫无反抗之力、随时会被碾成粉末的绝望。

    “想拥有这种力量，就得付出代价。”血怒收回双手，负在身后，“学院的规矩很简单，只有三条。”

    他竖起一根手指。

    “第一，学院内禁止杀人。有什么恩怨，上生死台解决。不上台，就不能动手。但...”

    他顿了顿，嘴角勾起一丝意味深长的笑，“我刚才说了，这个规矩只适用于被人发现的情况。要是你杀人的时候没人看见，事后也没人能找到证据，那就不算违反规矩。明白吗？”

    人群里响起一阵细微的骚动。

    伊森微微眯起眼。

    “第二。”血怒竖起第二根手指，“学期十年。十年内，必须达到二等巫师学徒，并且至少学会五个完整的戏法模型。达不到的，驱逐出院。没有例外，没有通融，没有第二次机会。”

    “第三。”血怒竖起第三根手指，“在学院里，干什么都要魔石。吃饭要魔石，住宿要魔石，听课要魔石，借书要魔石，买材料要魔石，请教老师要魔石......你想学任何东西，都得先掏魔石。”

    他放下手，目光扫过人群。

    “魔石从哪里来？家里给的，自己赚的，或者...从别人手里抢的。学院有无数工作，打工就能赚魔石。扫地的，洗碗的，喂魔兽的，整理材料的，当实验助手的，替老师跑腿的，什么活都有。只要肯干，饿不死。”

    他顿了顿，声音压低了几分。

    “但要记住，赚魔石不是目的，变强才是。别为了赚那几块魔石，耽误了修炼。十年时间，一晃就过。”

    话音落下，血怒抬起右手，朝广场东侧一指。

    “那边，是教学区。所有新生该学的基础知识，都在那里。冥想方法、巫术模型、符文基础、材料辨识，只要付得起魔石，随时可以听课。现在，都给我滚过去。”

    他话音落下，身形骤然扭曲。

    那古铜色的皮肤开始泛起诡异的血红色，肌肉在皮肤下剧烈蠕动，骨骼发出噼啪的爆响。只是一眨眼的功夫，那个精壮的中年男人消失了，取而代之的是一头巨大的血红色巨犬。

    它四足踏在虚空中，低下头，那双猩红色的眼睛扫过广场上的人群。

    “记住我的话。”血怒的声音从那巨犬口中传出，低沉如闷雷，“十年后，我希望还能看见你们当中一些人。”
content_en:
Bloody eyes swept across the few figures who were still persisting, and a trace of satisfaction flashed in their eyes.

    "Do you feel it?"

    His voice remained calm, as if the terrifying pressure had nothing to do with him.

    "This is power. The power of a second-level wizard. I just looked at you and didn't release any witchcraft. Only a few of you can stand. And I'm not that strong in the academy."

    The pressure suddenly disappeared.

    The freshmen who collapsed on the ground gasped for air, and some even couldn't help crying.

    At that moment, they really felt the breath of death.

    The kind of despair that has no resistance and will be crushed into powder at any time.

    "If you want to have this kind of power, you have to pay a price." Blood Fury retracted his hands and clasped them behind his back, "The rules of the academy are very simple, there are only three."

    He held up a finger.

    "First, killing is prohibited in the academy. If you have any grievances, go to the stage of life and death to resolve them. If you don't go to the stage, you can't take action. But..."

    He paused, and a meaningful smile appeared at the corner of his mouth. "As I said just now, this rule only applies to situations where someone is discovered. If no one sees you when you kill someone, and no one can find evidence afterwards, it is not a violation of the rules. Do you understand?"

    There was a slight commotion in the crowd.

    Ethan narrowed his eyes slightly.

    "Second." Blood Fury raised a second finger, "The semester is ten years. Within ten years, you must reach the level of second-class wizard apprentice and learn at least five complete sleight of hand models. Those who fail to achieve it will be expelled from the hospital. There will be no exceptions, no accommodations, and no second chances."

    "Third." Blood Fury raised a third finger, "In the academy, you need magic stones for everything. You need magic stones for eating, you need magic stones for accommodation, you need magic stones for attending classes, you need magic stones for borrowing books, you need magic stones for buying materials, you need magic stones for asking the teacher... If you want to learn anything, you have to get the magic stones first."

    He lowered his hand and scanned the crowd.

    "Where do magic stones come from? They are given by family, earned by oneself, or... snatched from other people's hands. There are countless jobs in the academy, and you can earn magic stones by working part-time. Those who sweep the floor, wash dishes, feed monsters, organize materials, work as experimental assistants, run errands for teachers, there are all kinds of jobs. As long as you are willing to work, you will never die of hunger."

    He paused and lowered his voice a bit.

    "But remember, earning magic stones is not the goal, becoming stronger is. Don't delay your practice just to earn those few magic stones. Ten years will pass by in a flash."

    After finishing his words, Xue Nu raised his right hand and pointed towards the east side of the square.

    "Over there is the teaching area. All the basic knowledge that new students should learn is there. Meditation methods, witchcraft models, basic runes, and material identification. As long as you can afford the magic stones, you can take classes at any time. Now, get over here."

    After he finished speaking, his figure suddenly twisted.

    The bronze skin began to turn a strange blood-red color, the muscles squirmed violently under the skin, and the bones made crackling sounds. In just the blink of an eye, the sturdy middle-aged man disappeared, replaced by a huge blood-red dog.

    It stood on all fours in the air, lowered its head, and scanned the crowd in the square with its scarlet eyes.

    "Remember my words." A blood-wrathed voice came from the giant dog's mouth, as low as thunder, "Ten years from now, I hope to see some of you again."
